_concept_card_fields: Per-concept fields the two-tier Concept split (book-models/landing_big_ideas_model.py) reads on top of the nine the landing bricks read. `mechanisms`: the hand-declared Concept->mechanism edge — a list of catalogue entry slugs (agent/models-bridge/product) that instantiate or enforce this concept; the owning side of the edge, may be [] for a thin entry; every slug must resolve to a real catalogue entry (checked by CC2). `related_ideas`: an optional curated override for the Related-concepts section — a list of the six concept slugs; [] means the projector falls back to the _order-adjacency seed. `entry_figures`: the concept ENTRY's extra figures (fig[1..]) beyond the shared brick figure fig[0] (=`figure`) — a list of {asset, caption} objects, each asset under book/assets/. Distinct from book/data/concepts.json (the book's core-concept vocabulary model with its own card-<slug> landing lints) — this file is the six Big-Ideas / Concepts-section model. churn.title: Engineering Capital — Churn vs. Compounding
churn.claim: One environment, two fates. Ungoverned, effort dissipates as churn — rediscovering, undoing, reconciling. Governed and converting, it accrues as engineering capital: the same effort compounds.
churn.more: A team of people slows under Brooks's Law; an agent fleet collapses when the work exceeds its window — that is churn, effort re-spent rediscovering and undoing. The same environment has a positive sign: govern each recurring failure and convert it, and the effort banks as engineering capital that lowers the cost of every later change. The fork is what the whole method decides; Part 6 cashes the compounding half.

entry_figures.caption: *The chain that ends in churn.* Reasoning state grows with the task; once it outruns working memory it is compacted, and lossy compaction degrades the reasoning it stands in for. The left branch ends in churn; the right shows the same task reasoned through a model, which loses less.

governance-centric.title: The Engineered Environment
governance-centric.claim: The environment is the object of engineering. Encode each obligation as a mechanism it enforces, so quality is a property of the ground agents stand on.
governance-centric.more: Velocity-centric hands work around a ring of job titles and leaves quality implicit; oversight-centric parks a human beside each change, and attention does not scale with the fleet. Governance pays attention per class of failure instead: once, when you build the mechanism that retires it.

modeling-thesis.title: Documentation, taken to its limit, is a structured model
modeling-thesis.claim: A context-bounded agent can't hold the whole system. Externalize what it must know, from context to drift-checked models, and the reasoning fits the window.
modeling-thesis.more: The climb is gradual: select the right context, connect it into typed knowledge, then harden it into drift-checked models — each rung answers more engineering questions without reading raw code. *In other words:* move the knowledge out of people's heads and into representations the next agent can start from. Models used to die because keeping them current was somebody's unpaid job; agents now do it for cents, and a drifted model fails the build where a drifted prose doc only lies quietly.

entry_figures.caption: *The reasoning horizon, and what a model does to it.* Reasoning state grows with a task's length; once it outruns working memory it must be compacted. Reason through a model and each compaction loses less, so the horizon stretches and the branch reaches progress instead of churn.

alignment-thesis.title: Hold intent with a mechanism: prevent first, sense the rest
alignment-thesis.claim: Give engineering intent authority over the fleet's work: constrain first so the wrong move is unavailable, and where prevention falls short, a sensor catches the drift.
alignment-thesis.more: A model by itself has no authority — it helps an engineer think and an agent navigate, but nothing forces the code to obey it. Alignment changes that: once intent is explicit enough to check, the environment can enforce it. **Represented intent becomes authority.** *In other words:* the model stops being advice and becomes something the build refuses to violate. A type the compiler checks, a validator weighing an artifact against its obligation, a gate that consumes the verdict — each holds a decision made once against every later change; costly goals earn several at once, and what none reaches stays a human job.

convert-failures.title: Convert recurring failures into controls
convert-failures.claim: Velocity surfaces the failures you could not foresee. Convert each recurring one into a mechanism, pushed as far toward hard enforcement as it will go.
convert-failures.more: Mechanisms sit on a spectrum from soft to hard: a convention or a brief aims the agent but cannot block it; a lint or a gate holds the line whether the agent cooperates or not. The second time a soft rule fails, move it right — the documented rule becomes a lint the agent cannot talk past.

entry_figures.caption: *The hardening loop.* A recurring failure is caught, then converted into a mechanism and pushed toward the hardest enforcement it admits, so the class cannot return. The control substrate grows one retired failure at a time.

seat-moves.title: The lifecycle stays, but now agents sit in the developer's seat
seat-moves.claim: SDLC becomes SELC: one seat reassigned, the lifecycle otherwise intact. The fleet writes the code; the engineer keeps the seats that were always the engineering.
seat-moves.more: The engineer flanks the fleet: models carry intent in on one side, judgment meets the output on the other. The seats the human keeps — requirements, specification, design, validation — were always the consequential ones; now they are the job.

_brick_only_note: new-problem / independent-convergence / research-agenda are the three landing ideas the website-v2 reorg added. They are now FOLDED INTO _order: each carries a hand-authored concept-<slug>.md ENTRY, so the two-tier model (landing_big_ideas_model.py) gates them under CC1-CC6 and their landing bands link '→ read the concept' rather than 'Read in the book'. The six main bands render them + churn + governance-centric + the thesis pair; convert-failures + seat-moves stay in _order (their entries + CQ1 answered_by join) but are DEMOTED off the six main bands into the back-matter reference strip (their bi-<slug> ids resolve there, keeping gate d + the orphan gate green). seat-moves carries an explicit related_ideas override so the appended _order slugs do not shift its adjacency-seeded Related row. The band figures carry their real shared-source assets: new-problem shows new-engineering-problem.svg (Classical vs Agentic SE, the inserted Environment stage) and governance-centric shows environment-as-object.svg (the environment as the object of engineering, obligations bound into it as mechanisms). These are the same SVGs the book's 1.1-the-printer front-figures inline, so the landing band and the book chapter cannot diverge — one figure source, two surfaces.

new-problem.title: The New Engineering Problem
new-problem.claim: When intelligence becomes a commodity, implementation stops being scarce. What is scarce is trust — so the engineer's object of work shifts from code to environment.
new-problem.more: The shift is recent and mechanical. Generative models did not make software easier to write so much as cheap to write, at a volume no reviewer can keep pace with. Writing became abundant while reading stayed human-slow — and everything that is hard now follows from that one inversion.

entry_figures.caption: *Where the work moves.* Most of the field tunes the agent and treats the environment as a passive backdrop. The shift this idea names runs the other way: the object of engineering jumps to the governed environment the agent operates inside.

independent-convergence.title: Independent Convergence
independent-convergence.claim: Six industrial systems, engineered independently, land on one set of principles. None generalizes the whole theory, yet each instantiates a distinct arm — convergence, not derivation.
independent-convergence.more: One system, however deeply studied, could always be the special case that flatters its own method. The test that carries weight is whether the constructs hold where no one had heard of the method — so the theory was read against six industrial systems built for entirely different reasons.

research-agenda.title: The Research Agenda
research-agenda.claim: Three open frontiers: how far judgment can migrate into deterministic machinery, how to census a governed environment's coverage and gaps, and what stronger models unlock.
research-agenda.more: These frontiers are not loose ends; they are where the method turns testable. Each names something you could measure against real systems rather than assert — how far an obligation can be pushed toward proof, what a governed environment's coverage actually is, and what the next tier of models makes cheap enough to retire by hand.

entry_figures.caption: *The census frontier, drawn.* Match obligations against the mechanisms that meet them and three counts fall out — governed, under-governed, and governance debt — so an environment's coverage becomes something you measure rather than assert.

gateway.kicker: Kept honest — the gateway to the catalogue
gateway.title: The models are the interface; the map is kept equal to the territory
gateway.claim: Two spines of models over one method trunk govern this very repo; the catalogue's mechanisms hold them true.
gateway.more: The models are the interface a context-bounded fleet operates a context-exceeding codebase through. Browse the mechanisms by the model they govern.

core_question.question: How do we safely grant autonomy to commodity intelligence?
core_question.software_specialization: When implementation becomes cheap enough that agents can build almost anything you can describe, what must the surrounding engineering environment do so they can act autonomously without making the system untrustworthy?

through_line.text: How do we safely grant autonomy to commodity intelligence?
Make intent explicit in models the fleet reasons through, and make the environment enforce the obligations that matter.
When autonomy exposes a new failure class, convert the lesson into durable structure so the next agent inherits a safer, more capable world.

core_question._note: The book's core question — the umbrella over the six Big Ideas. NOT a concept record (no book_home/figure/claim) and NOT projected as a landing band; a CHECKED ANCHOR whose only render is the Preface prose, pinned by parity. `answered_by` names the three ideas that constitute the ANSWER (the other three — churn/governance-centric/seat-moves — frame problem/stance/seat), in the LANDING slug namespace; `answer_constructs` names the same answer in the CONSTRUCT-UNIVERSE namespace (thesis-*/governance-conversion) that a deferred industry_cases `generalizes` query reads, so a single declared 'answer' is readable by both models.
